units.source_text: 因有上述种种烦扰之事，尚侍玉鬘心情更加郁结，没有开朗的时候了。

en.t: Because of all the troubles described above, the Naishi no Kami Tamakazura grew still more depressed and no longer had any cheerful moments.

units.source_text: 髭黑大将觉得对她不起，总想设法安慰她。

en.t: General Higekuro felt he had wronged her and was always trying to find some way to comfort her.

units.source_text: 他想：“她要入宫，我不赞成，阻碍行期，深恐皇上责我不敬，

en.t: He thought, If she is to enter the palace and I oppose it, delaying her departure, I fear deeply that His Majesty will accuse me of disrespect,
and think that I have some hidden motive.
The Chancellor and the others will also find my conduct suspicious.

units.source_text: 以女官为妻，并非没有前例，我就让她去吧。”

en.t: There are precedents for taking a court lady as a wife, so I shall let her go.

units.source_text: 他念头一转，就在开年之后送玉鬘入宫。

en.t: Once his thinking changed, he sent Tamakazura into the palace after the new year.
